title: Query commands use issue compaction
description: When a CLI feature queries for issue information, return the most-recent summary comment if one exists instead of raw data.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Feature: Issue querying uses compaction
  Scenario: Querying an issue with a summary
    Given an issue with a comment of type "summary"
    When I query the issue via CLI commands (e.g. kbs show or kbs list)
    Then the system returns the data from the most-recent summary comment
    And it does not try to return the original raw data

comments.author: box
comments.text:
## QA acceptance failure (2026-08-27)

This story is closed, but the acceptance scenario fails on `main`.

**Given** an issue with `comment_type: summary` (`tskl-qi1`, three `system:summary` comments from 2026-08-23)
**When** I query it with `kanbus show tskl-qi1`
**Then** Python 0.19.1 raises `ValidationError: summary comment requires data.rewritten_description`
**And** it does not return the summary.

Those summaries are legacy `text`-only. Current compaction writes `data.rewritten_description` + `data.activity_summary`. Readers must accept the summaries already on this board, or we need a one-time repair of `tskl-qi1` (and any other text-only summaries).

Parent epic: **kbs-74dfa9**. GitHub: Kanbus PR #167 has a reader-side fix; it is not on `main` yet.

Please reopen or file a child bug under the epic. A compacted issue must never take down `show` / `list`.
